**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), §6(a).**

- **Issue:** The only convenience-termination right (§6(a), 15 days' notice, mutual) is gated on there being *no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding*. Since all substantive work and fees sit in SOWs, Clear Capital has no ability to exit an active engagement for convenience — failing even the fallback (60–90 days' notice), with no prepaid-fee refund.
- **Direction check:** RadialSpark's side is already at the preferred position — the Contractor equally cannot walk away while an SOW is live — so I left the mutual 15-day no-SOW right untouched rather than flagging it.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** appended to §6(a) a Company right to terminate the Agreement or any SOW for convenience, in whole or in part, on 30 days' written notice, with refund of prepaid fees for Services not performed. §6(b) already caps Contractor's recovery at fees earned through termination, and there is no early-termination fee to strike.
